Following requested overhead research, isolate the classifier from configured Chat reasoning effort and always request protocol-native reasoning disable when current account metadata and the classifier-only public model both advertise/support off: Responses and Completions none, Anthropic disabled. Fail closed before dispatch when either proof is absent; do not change shared model maps or ordinary Chat behavior. Synthetic payloads establish serialization, not supplier internals. Retain classification, category routing, weights, continuity, no-tools, 128-token output, omitted-context safety, account/exclusion gates, cancellation and one-call/no-retry ownership. Keep fixed diagnostic cohorts and legacy unrecorded reasons. Defer benchmark/adaptive optimal-model selection until representative accuracy/latency/cost evidence and separate consent; do not infer classifier/network failure from unknown demand.
